name: Sun Xiang
current_role: Reported president of Sinogiant Group (Xinhua United Metallurgical Holding Group), chaired by his father Sun Jimu
profile: Sun Xiang is linked to Sinogiant Group (新华联合冶金控股集团), a private Chinese iron and steel holding company founded by his father Sun Jimu, with steel complexes in Huanghua (Cangzhou) and Tangshan, Hebei. The family shared a Hurun listing (2011-2018). Little recent public information.
interesting_fact: Sinogiant was formed in 2004 as the holding entity for Sun Jimu's industrial interests; one profile says Sun Xiang was formerly a delegate to the Hebei Provincial People's Congress (single source).
notes: Only single-source confirmation of Sun Xiang's role; wealth shared with father Sun Jimu. Very low public profile, Chinese-language channels only. Not on lists since 2018.
